name: app-pixel-art-collectible-card-reveal-screen-in-mint-on-dark
title: Pixel Collectible Card Reveal Screen
whatItIs: A phone screenshot of a year-in-review feature with a dark halftone-dot background and mint accents: a mint collectible card with a level bar, a pixel-art sleepy donut character, a heavy title and small badges, and a lower panel 'Our gift to you' with a black Claim Now button with an offset outline, a pixel avatar and dotted page progress with a boxed arrow.
whatItMeans: Pixel art, dotted textures and offset outlines create a playful retro-game mood that makes a summary feel like a reward.
techniques: Pixel-art character on a mint dither gradient
Halftone dot texture on a dark background
Offset outline on buttons and arrow tile

vocabulary.definition: A dot pattern giving a printed or dithered texture.
A card with a level, title, number and badges like a trading card.
An outline shifted behind a shape for a hard shadow effect.
